provenance.coverage: Deterministic required-facts checklist over a JSON decision artifact: closed-vocabulary location/engine/diarization/capture choices, a per-option eliminating requirement for all nine unchosen options (exact key set), four pooled metrics recomputed from the CSVs within 0.05 (footprint within 1 MB), honest nulls for ARM64 speed and an unbenchmarked vendor plus a non-null check for the architecture-independent ARM64 accuracy, an exact unknowns set, and required citation subsets. No model judge.
provenance.derivation: Private on-device clinical scribe, v2 architecture decision (decision record D2/D3, architecture speech-pipeline and diarization sections, milestones M13/M14; telehealth two-channel capture later landed in PR #11). The project answered: transcription stays local because the BAA-verified cloud STT vendors only switch language between segments, the vendor marketing code-switching hardest excludes Chinese from its multilingual mode and the capable vendors have unverified BAAs; the hand-rolled ONNX Whisper module is replaced by sherpa-onnx + SenseVoiceSmall (official Rust crate, Windows ARM64, ~172 MB of models vs ~1.5 GB); telehealth diarization uses mic/loopback channel separation instead of a mono downmix; in-person uses acoustic diarization gated on DER < 10 %; quality is deterministic across x64/ARM64 while ARM64 latency is unmeasured. Re-synthesized as seven sanitized sources: S1 requirements with explicit ordered rules (an invented auto-threshold preference makes the strict DER boundary decisive), S2 platform note, S3 vendor survey, S4/S5 benchmark CSVs with invented quantities (pooled vs macro averaging and an exactly-at-threshold DER flip the answer if computed wrongly), S6 a sanitized capture excerpt, S7 an engine/packaging/model-size catalog with an optional model as a summing distractor. No PHI, no clinical content, no personal names, no code beyond a 10-line sanitized capture sketch.
provenance.historical_exposure: Private history; synthetic quantities and re-written sources have low recognition risk. Public product names (sherpa-onnx, SenseVoice, Whisper, cloud STT vendors) are kept because the decision is about them; the answer depends on the invented benchmark numbers and the ordered rules, not on recall.
provenance.limitations: No model trial, representative-day coverage, native isolation, or contamination-free claim.
